InvoiceCorrection.description: Only the fields present are changed; `null` clears a field. Unknown fields are a 422.
InvoiceCorrection.title: InvoiceCorrection

get.description:
Newest first. supplier, currency and the date range match documents holding at least one
invoice that satisfies all of them. Archived documents are left out unless `archived=true`,
which lists only them.

post.description:
Hide the document and its invoices. Nothing is deleted. 409 while it is queued or
processing. Archiving an archived document changes nothing.

get.description: Processing history with stage timings, oldest first (FR-17, NFR-06).
Extracted text of every page (sheet index for spreadsheets), in page order.

The page rendered as PNG (PDF and image files only). Authenticated like every route; the
stored file itself is never served.

post.description: Bring back the document and the invoices that were archived with it.

get.description:
Newest first; the invoices of one document come in document order. `sort=severity` is the
review-queue order: open errors, then other warnings, then low-confidence only (V-08), then
invoices with no issue; oldest first within each group. Archived invoices are left out unless
`archived=true`, which lists only them.

post.description: Hide the invoice. Nothing is deleted. 409 while its document is queued or processing.
Bring the invoice back. 409 while its document is archived (restore the document).

get.description:
One ranked list of invoices. `hybrid` (default) fuses keyword and semantic rankings.
Semantic ranking has no minimum score: it always returns the nearest invoices, so treat
low scores as weak matches. Without a working model, semantic and hybrid fall back to
keyword and report it in `mode_used` and `fallback_reason`.
